content:
maya: Quick async check for PeregrineLabs private cutover (Thu 10am PT). Need network owners to confirm last-mile items: firewall CIDRs, NAT mode, proxy creds, air-gap image delivery, and KMS endpoint reachability. Who can take egress + certs?
noah: I can take egress. Can you drop the exact CIDRs/FQDNs we need to allow?
maya: TL;DR list below + linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/peregrine-cutover (private).
- allowlist CIDRs: 3.21.45.0/24, 52.44.128.0/20
- FQDNs: s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com, repo.peregrine.internal, kms.peregrine.lcl
- ports: 443, 22 (for scp mirror), 123 (ntp), 443/tcp for KMS TLS
riley: Question: are they using NAT gateway or 1:1 public IPs for egress? If NAT, need expected concurrent connections to estimate SNAT port exhaustion. Also need their proxy intercept details (hostname + auth method).
sam: Peregrine confirmed they plan to use a Squid jumpbox + repo mirror. They said no direct outbound 443 from app subnets. Plan: we provide signed offline image bundle that they pull via scp from the jumpbox. Need our public signing key and manifest.
maya: We have signed bundles for v1.2. @infra-bot can you generate the presigned transfer URL and attach the signing pubkey here?
infra-bot: presign-bot: Presigned URL created for peregrine v1.2 bundle: https://s3.redwood/internal/peregrine/v1.2.tgz (expires in 48h). SHA256: d2f9...a7c. Public signing key: -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
MIIBIjANBgkq...IDAQAB
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----
noah: If they're pulling via jumpbox, confirm TLS cert pinning or we risk MITM. Also need to validate time sync — NTP (UDP 123) must be allowed from their jumpbox to our time servers for cert validations.
riley: Also: for KMS — do they want us to call their KMS endpoint, or will they wrap keys and hand us a wrapped key? For private deployments we support customer KMS endpoints over VPN; we just need the endpoint IP/port and TLS certs to add to allowlist.
maya: I'll ask Peregrine which option. Add note: we need 3 things before cutover: (1) egress allowlist + NAT model, (2) jumpbox image transfer tested, (3) KMS connectivity and certs.
sam: Can someone paste a brief checklist I can drop into the runbook? I'll own updating the ops steps and the canary playbook.
maya: Copyable checklist below — owners next to items.
```
[ ] Egress allowlist (noah) — CIDRs/FQDNs verified and firewall rules in place
[ ] NAT model decision (riley) — NAT vs 1:1 + port calculations
[ ] Jumpbox transfer (sam) — test scp of bundle + SHA verification
[ ] KMS connectivity (riley) — endpoint IP/port + certs added to allowlist
[ ] Time sync (noah) — NTP permitted from jumpbox
[ ] Image signature verification (infra-bot) — pubkey + manifest in runbook
[ ] Post-cutover smoke (maya) — end-to-end inference smoke test
```
noah: Sounds good. I’ll run a SNAT port calc once they confirm concurrent connections. Ping me the expected client count.
riley: I’ll add KMS endpoint to the preflight checklist template. If customer uses HSM over a private link, we may need a route to their dedicated appliance — ask them for ASN and route prep.
maya: Thanks — I’ll ping the customer now and update this thread. Plan to re-run the preflight tomorrow 08:00 PT and lock the cutover if green. :white_check_mark:
